attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across the 3-node RHEL 10 cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only physical standbys connected via dedicated replication slots over async streaming. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot IDs and full data/replication recovery after each restart.
